tasks.title: CAN bus resistance
tasks.statement: The bus has **{n}** terminator(s) of 120 Ω each. What will a multimeter show between CAN_H and CAN_L with the power off (Ω)?
tasks.solution: Terminators in parallel: 120 / n. The correct number is two, 60 Ω.

tasks.title: CAN bus load
tasks.statement: The bus carries **{f} frames/s**, a frame with an extended ID and 8 bytes ≈ **{b} bits** with bit stuffing, bitrate 1 Mbit/s. Find the bus load (%).
